card.name: Linking word between chemotherapy drug names
card.fires_on: The joining word 'and' (or '+', 'δ') right after a chemotherapy drug name, just before the next drug in a combination such as cytarabine or cyclophosphamide. Also the δ in δ-aminolevulinic acid.
